verdict.rationale: llama.cpp ships an official `llama cli` binary (and `llama serve`) directly from the project, supporting text and VLM sessions, and is corroborated by hands-on community reports of using CLI/binaries. missing for 10: no independent deep-dive review of CLI ergonomics/agentic scripting features, and no documentation of CLI-specific flags for automation/agent workflows beyond basic usage examples.
